name: Peace Lily
description: An elegant indoor plant known for purifying the air. Care & Planting: Plant in well-draining soil. Requires low to medium indirect light and keep the soil lightly moist.

reviews.comment: Beautiful plant, arrived in great condition.

name: Sansevieria
description: An extremely resilient and elegant plant. Care & Planting: Plant in cactus/succulent mix. A great choice for beginners as it requires very little water. Allow soil to dry completely between waterings.

name: Hydrangea
description: A gorgeous outdoor shrub with large, round flower clusters. Care & Planting: Plant in rich, porous soil. Prefers partial shade and regular, deep watering, especially during dry spells.

reviews.comment: Bloomed beautifully in my garden this summer!

name: Red Rose Bouquet
description: A classic bouquet of 11 fresh red roses, the perfect gift for special occasions. Care: Trim stems at a 45-degree angle and change the vase water every two days to maintain freshness.

reviews.comment: My wife loved them, very fragrant.

name: Monstera
description: A tropical beauty with distinctive split leaves. Brings a jungle vibe to any space. Care & Planting: Plant in peat-based potting soil with a moss pole for support. Needs bright indirect light and weekly watering.

reviews.comment: Growing so fast! A new leaf already popped up.

name: Epiphyllum oxypetalum
description: Also known as the Queen of the Night, a rare cactus that blooms magnificent white flowers only at night. Care & Planting: Plant in an airy, well-draining cactus mix. Prefers bright, indirect sunlight and higher humidity. Water when the top inch of soil is dry.

reviews.comment: Watching it bloom at night is a magical experience!

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: A stunning statement plant with large, veined, violin-shaped leaves. Care & Planting: Needs well-draining soil and a pot with drainage holes. Thrives in bright, indirect sunlight. Water thoroughly but allow the top soil to dry out between waterings.

reviews.comment: Looks amazing in my living room, though a bit dramatic with watering.

name: English Lavender
description: A fragrant, herbaceous perennial known for its beautiful purple spikes. Care & Planting: Plant in alkaline, sandy, well-draining soil. Requires full sun for at least 6 hours a day. Drought tolerant once established.

reviews.comment: Smells incredible and attracts so many bees!

name: Sunflower Bouquet
description: A bright and cheerful arrangement of 7 large sunflowers. Care: Cut the stems at an angle under running water. Keep out of direct sunlight to make the blooms last longer, and change water daily.

reviews.comment: Brought so much sunshine to my kitchen table.

name: Golden Pothos
description: An incredibly hardy trailing vine with heart-shaped, variegated leaves. Care & Planting: Plant in standard potting mix. Survives in low light but thrives in medium indirect light. Water when the top half of the soil feels dry.

reviews.comment: Practically unkillable and grows super fast.

name: Aloe Vera
description: A popular medicinal succulent with thick, fleshy green leaves. Care & Planting: Plant in succulent or cactus mix. Needs bright, indirect sunlight. Water deeply but infrequently, ensuring the soil is totally dry first.

reviews.comment: Great plant, and very handy for minor kitchen burns.

name: Phalaenopsis Orchid
description: An elegant, long-blooming orchid with vibrant, moth-shaped flowers. Care & Planting: Plant in a bark-based orchid potting mix. Thrives in bright, indirect light. Water weakly but weekly, avoiding standing water.

reviews.comment: The blooms lasted for nearly three months!

name: ZZ Plant
description: Features dark green, glossy leaves and is famous for surviving extreme neglect. Care & Planting: Regular potting soil is fine. Tolerates very low light. Needs watering only once every few weeks.

name: Spider Plant
description: A popular hanging plant known for producing trailing 'spiderettes'. Care & Planting: Use an all-purpose potting mix. Enjoys bright to moderate indirect sunlight. Keep soil slightly moist but not soggy.

reviews.comment: Already making babies! Looks great in a macrame hanger.

name: Spring Tulip Bouquet
description: A vibrant mix of 15 colorful spring tulips. Care: Trim stems underwater to prevent air bubbles. Keep in a cool room away from direct sunlight and top up with fresh, cold water daily.

reviews.comment: So fresh and colorful, brightened up the whole room.

name: Jade Plant
description: A popular succulent houseplant with thick, oval-shaped leaves, often considered a symbol of good luck. Care & Planting: Best in a heavy, well-draining pot with cactus mix. Loves bright light. Let the soil dry completely before watering.

reviews.comment: Very low maintenance and looks like a tiny tree.
